# **AI Communication & Outreach Platform – System Design Overview**

## **1\. Project Goal**

The goal of this system is to build an AI-powered communication and automation platform that helps the company manage client interactions, qualify leads, automate outreach campaigns, and integrate with CRM tools.

The platform will serve as a core internal system that improves client response time, increases consultation bookings, strengthens industry partnerships, and supports business growth through intelligent automation.

The system will combine AI-driven communication, workflow automation, and CRM integration to streamline both inbound client communication and outbound business outreach.

---

# **2\. Client Requirement Verification**

The proposed system fully satisfies the client requirements described in the original specification.

### **Client Communication**

The AI agent will be able to:

• Respond to incoming emails, SMS messages, and website chat messages  
 • Answer common client questions automatically using AI  
 • Send consultation booking links  
 • Confirm meetings and send reminders  
 • Escalate complex conversations to human staff when necessary

This ensures fast response times and improves client satisfaction.

---

### **Lead Qualification**

The AI system will automatically:

• Ask qualifying questions to new leads  
 • Capture important lead information such as project scope, budget, and timeline  
 • Identify qualified vs non-qualified leads  
 • Send intake forms or questionnaires  
 • Book consultations automatically when leads meet qualification criteria

---

### **Business Outreach**

The platform will support automated outreach to industry professionals such as:

• Contractors  
 • Real estate agents  
 • Developers  
 • Architects  
 • Home builders

Outreach capabilities include:

• Sending personalized outreach messages  
 • Automatically following up with prospects  
 • Tracking responses  
 • Converting responses into conversations  
 • Booking partnership calls

---

### **CRM Integration**

The system will integrate with:

• GoHighLevel CRM (primary CRM system)  
 • Email providers  
 • SMS messaging services  
 • Calendly or calendar scheduling tools  
 • Google Sheets or other CRM tracking tools

These integrations allow the system to automatically sync contacts, deals, and conversation activity.

---

### **Automation & Workflow Creation**

The platform will support automated workflows that can:

• Organize incoming leads  
 • Update CRM records  
 • Create follow-up tasks  
 • Trigger automated messages  
 • Move leads through the sales pipeline

---

### **Smart Decision Making**

The AI system will be capable of:

• Understanding conversation intent  
 • Determining when to respond automatically  
 • Escalating important conversations to human staff  
 • Maintaining a professional tone in all responses  
 • Learning from conversation history over time

---

# **3\. System Architecture Overview**

The system architecture is composed of several layers.

### **Communication Layer**

This layer handles inbound and outbound messages across multiple channels such as email, SMS, and website chat.

It captures incoming messages through webhooks and forwards them into the backend system.

---

### **Backend Orchestration Layer**

The backend is built using **FastAPI** and acts as the central system responsible for:

• message processing  
 • workflow automation  
 • CRM updates  
 • integration with external services

---

### **AI Intelligence Layer**

The AI layer processes incoming messages and determines how the system should respond.

This includes:

• message intent detection  
 • response generation  
 • lead qualification  
 • conversation summarization

---

### **Workflow Automation Layer**

This layer handles automated business processes such as:

• follow-up reminders  
 • pipeline updates  
 • meeting scheduling  
 • CRM updates

Workflows are triggered by events such as new messages, lead qualification results, or scheduled tasks.

---

### **Integration Layer**

This layer connects the system to third-party services such as:

• Email providers  
 • SMS gateways  
 • CRM systems  
 • Calendar services

---

# **4\. Technology Stack**

The system uses the following technologies.

Frontend  
 Next.js – used for the internal dashboard where staff manage campaigns, leads, and conversations.

Backend  
 FastAPI – handles API services, automation workflows, and integrations.

Database  
 PostgreSQL – stores contacts, conversations, messages, campaigns, and CRM data.

Caching / Queue System  
 Redis – used for caching, background jobs, and message processing.

AI Frameworks  
 LangChain – used for AI interactions and prompt management.  
 LangGraph – used for orchestrating multi-step AI workflows.

API Gateway  
 Acts as the central entry point for all external and internal API requests.

---

# **5\. Role of LangChain**

LangChain will be used to manage interactions with AI models.

Its responsibilities include:

• managing prompt templates  
 • calling LLM APIs  
 • parsing message content  
 • integrating external tools  
 • retrieving knowledge from the knowledge base (RAG)

LangChain simplifies the process of building structured AI pipelines.

---

# **6\. Role of LangGraph**

LangGraph will orchestrate complex AI workflows.

Instead of single AI calls, conversations will follow a multi-step reasoning process.

Example LangGraph workflow:

Message received  
 ↓  
 Classify intent  
 ↓  
 Check lead qualification stage  
 ↓  
 Decide next action  
 ↓  
 Generate response

This allows the AI agent to behave more like a decision-making assistant rather than a simple chatbot.

---

# **7\. Role of Redis**

Redis will support several important functions.

### **Message Queue**

Redis will queue tasks such as:

• AI processing  
 • campaign message sending  
 • background workflows

This prevents the system from blocking during heavy workloads.

---

### **Caching**

Redis will temporarily store:

• conversation context  
 • frequently accessed data  
 • AI session state

This improves system performance.

---

---

# **8\. API Gateway**

The API Gateway serves as the main entry point for all API requests.

Responsibilities include:

• routing requests to FastAPI services  
 • handling authentication  
 • applying rate limits  
 • managing incoming webhooks  
 • simplifying external integrations

Example flow:

Email provider webhook  
 ↓  
 API Gateway  
 ↓  
 FastAPI service  
 ↓  
 message processing

---

# **9\. End-to-End System Flow Example**

Below is a typical system workflow.

Step 1  
 Admin imports contacts or lead lists into the platform.

Step 2  
 Admin creates an outreach campaign targeting architects.

Step 3  
 The system sends outreach messages through email or SMS integrations.

Step 4  
 A prospect replies to the outreach message.

Step 5  
 The email provider sends the reply to the system through a webhook.

Step 6  
 The webhook request reaches the API Gateway.

Step 7  
 The API Gateway forwards the request to the FastAPI backend.

Step 8  
 The system searches for an existing contact or creates a new contact.

Step 9  
 A conversation thread is created for the contact.

Step 10  
 The message is stored in the database.

Step 11  
 Redis queues an AI processing task.

Step 12  
 LangGraph starts the AI workflow.

Step 13  
 LangChain calls the language model.

Step 14  
 The AI analyzes the message intent and generates a response.

Step 15  
 The response is sent back through the original channel.

Step 16  
 The AI begins lead qualification by asking questions.

Step 17  
 If the lead is qualified, the system sends a consultation booking link.

Step 18  
 When the meeting is booked, the CRM is automatically updated.

---

# **10\. Business Impact**

Once deployed, this system will provide several key business benefits.

• Faster response time for client inquiries  
 • Improved client satisfaction  
 • Increased consultation bookings  
 • Automated outreach to industry partners  
 • Better lead organization and pipeline tracking  
 • Reduced manual work for the sales team

The platform enables the company to scale communication and business development using intelligent automation.
